# authentik_request_rule (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authentik_request_rule" "example" {
  name                       = "Example access request rule"
  policy_engine_mode         = "any"
  notification_mode          = "all"
  min_reviewers              = 1
  min_reviewers_is_per_group = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `min_reviewers` (Number) Generated.
- `min_reviewers_is_per_group` (Boolean) Generated.
- `notification_mode` (String) Allowed values:

  - `direct`

 Generated.
- `notification_transports` (List of String)
- `policy_engine_mode` (String) Allowed values:

 Generated.
- `request_flow` (String) UUID or slug of the flow shown to the requester when creating a request against this rule.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `targets` (List of String) Objects currently bound to this rule, derived from its request rule bindings. Generated.
